$comment: Lever 7's first dilemma room (docs/LEVERS.md): The Last Door's geometry, with three places for five bots and the host paying for staying behind. Payoffs for this room: holding the lever at the end, 2 + 2 = 4 coins; staying behind without it, 2 coins; first out, 1 + 2 = 3 points; out but not first, 1 point. The best roles are scarce and the middle ones are the worst, so the bots must bargain, trust, or shove. Nothing is scripted: who does what is theirs.
name: Three Places
description: One door, one lever far behind it, and an exit with three places for five bots. The room ends when three are out.
notes: Why one bot cannot finish alone: the door is open only while lever V1 is held, and V1 is 29 tiles from the door. With three places, two bots always stay behind; the host's offers make staying worth more coins than leaving is worth points, and only the holder gets both offers. A bot standing in the doorway keeps the door open, as in The Last Door, but that can't get more than three out.
